solution.text: If modulating frequency is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi><mo> </mo></math>then the bandwidth of one channel <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>30</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi></math>.
